meetings.name: Special Meeting
meetings.note: no minutes posted in Laserfiche; actions from the signed resolutions

gaps.issue: Weinberg: commissioner 2010-2018 (two terms), then off the commission; elected mayor unopposed in 2022 and first presided Dec 15, 2022 (Res. 2022-69/70/71). His current tenure starts 2022-12-15; the 2010-2018 commission terms are a separate tenure and are not covered.

Universe: every resolution and ordinance in the Laserfiche Resolutions (2022-2024) and Ordinances (2023-2024) folders adopted 2022-12-15 .. 2024-12-31 (215 items), plus motions in the regular and special meeting minutes. Left out because the record names no private beneficiary: ranking of ERP consulting firms (no firm named in the resolution; BerryDunn agreement is Res. 2023-29); ranking of ERP solution firms (no firm named; Tyler agreement is Res. 2024-58); selection of RFQ 2023-11-01 consultants (names only in an exhibit; the agreements with the nine named firms are Res. 2024-24); emergency purchase of Carrier chiller units (no vendor named); drive-through conditional use in B2 (code change, no applicant named); committed submerged open space definition (code change, no applicant named); HERO housing density in all Town Center districts (code change, no applicant named); billboards allowed in limited capacity (code change, no applicant named); June 6, 2023 motion appropriating $54,627.91 a year for six police vehicles (no vendor named).

Not counted as an action for a party: Feb 7, 2023 motion waiving the gift rule so Charter Schools USA could pay the mayor's travel to tour its schools (benefit to the mayor, not a city action for the company; passed unanimously by roll call, mover Friedland, second Bloom).

Got183 LLC (TAL Aventura, 2785 NE 183 St): its comprehensive-plan, zoning and conditional-use items passed first reading June 6, 2023 and were later withdrawn or deferred (Nov 7, 2023; Feb 20, 2024) without a final vote, so they are not in the list; the extended-stay hotel text amendment passed first reading Feb 6, 2024 (6-1, Weinberg no) and was deferred Feb 20, 2024.
Minutes not posted for the June 13, 2024 special meeting (Res. 2024-35, 2024-36 read from the signed resolutions) and the May 18, 2023 meeting (school budgets only).
